title: spring.http-client
description: Two buckets: spring.http-client.default holds family-wide values (each overridable per instance), spring.http-client.instances.<name> holds one client per named entry. No other key belongs directly under spring.http-client.

default.description: Family-wide values, each overridable by an instance.

driver.description: Names the Driver bean that assembles every instance's transport unless an instance names its own. Empty injects the single Driver bean by type (nil-safe fallback to DefaultDriver); set to a bean name to select one explicitly — naming a missing bean fails startup.

instances.description: One client per entry; the key is the bean name, and any name is legal.

driver.description: Names the Driver bean that assembles this instance's transport, overriding spring.http-client.default.driver. Empty falls back to the family-wide default, then to the single Driver bean by type.

tls.description: Per-entry TLS config; wired into the transport's TLS config when enabled
